content: To begin using the formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to access specific features and information related to those plans. The information provided above is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. It is important to note that individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the relevant plan provider directly. By proceeding with the send action, you acknowledge that you are authorized to share this information with the recipient via email.
